ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Execution via Flock - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the "flock" command to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/flock$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/bash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/dash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/fish.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/zsh.*")))
